subject: UKFast — post-demo privacy & compliance next steps (DPA, SCC module, SOC 2)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Clark <sophie.clark@ukfast.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@ukfast.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: UKFast — post-demo privacy & compliance next steps (DPA, SCC module, SOC 2)

Hi Sophie / Tom — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum on the procurement path: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in-scope for infrastructure. Could you confirm the date of the latest report and whether a read-only snapshot or bridge letter is available for vendors? We can accept a redacted snapshot for initial evaluation.

2) HIPAA / regulated data: you flagged some workloads that may touch PHI. Please confirm which product flows (if any) will include PHI so we can surface HIPAA-specific controls and BA considerations.

3) GDPR / DPA & SCCs: To move contracting forward, we typically provide a DPA draft and recommend which SCC module is appropriate. Based on our discussion, Redwood will likely be acting as a processor for hosted inference (model inputs/outputs are customer data). Our recommendation is to provisionally align on Module Two (Controller-to-Processor) but we want legal confirmation from your team.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): You offered to share your VSQ. If you send the spreadsheet we’ll assign our security engineering lead to complete the technical controls section.

5) Timeline & asks (proposed):
  - Sophie: SOC 2 snapshot or bridge letter by EOD Thu (2027-03-04)
  - Tom / Legal: confirmation on controller vs processor stance by next Tue (2027-03-09)
  - Redwood: we’ll drop an editable DPA + SCC module guidance (first draft) for your review by Fri (2027-03-05)

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx (first-pass, editable) — this is a standard processor DPA with placeholders for SCC selection and data flow notes.

If that timeline looks OK I’ll loop Marissa (legal) and Jordan (security) into the next thread for redlines and the VSQ.

Cheers,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx (editable DPA draft)

From: Sophie Clark <sophie.clark@ukfast.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@ukfast.com>, Legal Team <legal@ukfast.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: UKFast — post-demo privacy & compliance next steps (DPA, SCC module, SOC 2)

Thanks Karthik — good recap. A few quick responses: 

- SOC 2: we completed a Type II in Jan 2027. I can share a redacted snapshot (PDF) and a bridge note — I'll upload to our secure drive and add the link here. Expect that by tomorrow EOD.

- HIPAA: the workloads we discussed are scoped as "non-PHI" for the pilot. There are downstream connectors that could accept PHI in production; for now pilot is non-PHI but we'll confirm scope in the next call.

- Controller / Processor: our default position is that UKFast is the controller for customer data; we expect vendors to be processors. Legal will confirm formally but I don't expect they will push back on Module Two being the right SCC module.

- Vendor questionnaire: attached is the VSQ in spreadsheet form — Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_UKFast.xlsx. Please note the deadline for return is 2027-03-12 to stay on our procurement timeline.

We reviewed your DPA draft briefly and will circulate to Legal — thanks for sending it over.

Link: https://drive.ukfast.com/shared/soc2/snapshot-2027-02.pdf

Sophie Clark
Senior Procurement Manager, UKFast
S: +44 161 222 3333

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_UKFast.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: UKFast — post-demo privacy & compliance next steps (DPA, SCC module, SOC 2)

Hi Sophie — looping in from Redwood Legal. Thanks for the VSQ and SOC 2 link — helpful. A couple of clarifying points from our side to make sure contract language matches the operational model: 

1) Role confirmation: as Karthik noted, for hosted inference Redwood will operate as a processor for customer inputs/outputs. If UKFast requires any co-processing or joint-determination clauses, flag those now. Otherwise we'll proceed with a processor DPA + Module Two SCCs.

2) Data flows & sub-processing: please provide (or confirm) a short data flow sentence we can drop into the DPA describing what constitutes customer data in this relationship (e.g., "Customer-provided text and metadata submitted to Redwood API for inference; no persistent storage beyond token cache retention policies"). That will speed legal review.

3) HIPAA consideration: since the pilot is non-PHI, we'll keep BA terms out of the initial DPA but leave a clear contract pathway to add BA and HIPAA terms if/when flows change.

4) VSQ turnaround: Jordan and I can commit to an initial pass on the VSQ by Mon 2027-03-08. Can you confirm the preferred return format (spreadsheet with comments vs annotated PDF)?

Next steps (from Redwood Legal / Security):
  - We will update the DPA to include Module Two as the proposed SCC module and a short data-flow sentence — target Mon 2027-03-08.
  - Security to start the VSQ review; we may request follow-up evidence for control items.

If that works we'll keep the HubSpot deal updated with milestones. Karthik will coordinate the final legal touchpoints.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Contracts & Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. A few updates from Legal / Procurement: 

- SOC 2 snapshot link (redacted PDF) is here: https://drive.ukfast.com/shared/soc2/snapshot-2027-02.pdf (publicly accessible link for this thread).

- The VSQ: we prefer the spreadsheet with inline comments for faster review; I have attached the blank original but will accept your returned spreadsheet. Procurement asks that completed VSQs be returned by 2027-03-12 to avoid gating the pilot.

- Controller / Processor: legal has confirmed initial stance — Module Two (Controller-to-Processor) is the expected route. They asked only that we add a short data flow sentence and confirm subprocessor list commitments and deletion/retention windows.

We appreciate you proposing the DPA + Module Two. Please return the edited DPA and the completed VSQ by EOD 2027-03-10 if possible so we can push into the final procurement pack.

Tom (cc) — looping you to confirm procurement timelines from your side.

Regards,
Sophie Clark
